lead.headline: They are overhead: what we know about the figures crossing the sky

media.alt: Red-orange sky over a city skyline with dark shapes high above
media.caption: The sky over lower Manhattan shortly after 6 p.m. Eastern.

paragraphs: It started as a color. Shortly after 6 p.m. Eastern, the sky over New York began to darken toward red, and within the hour the same thing was being reported from Lagos, Warsaw, and Buenos Aires. Then came the shapes: dozens, then hundreds, of dark figures crossing the sky at an altitude no bird reaches, moving slowly, deliberately, and in no direction anyone could predict.

Officials have offered little beyond instructions to stay indoors. Pilots who were airborne when the sightings began have been grounded and are not speaking to reporters. Witnesses who saw the figures closest describe them in fragments: tall, ragged, carried on something long and narrow, and wrong in a way they struggle to put into words. Many say the worst part is the sound, a muffled, layered howl that doesn't stop when you close the windows.
